title_zh: 约好改短羊毛外套袖子

scenario.goal_zh: 根据试穿结果确定外套袖长的调整并约好取件

context_zh: 伊内兹带着过长的羊毛外套到裁缝店，请裁缝保罗评估袖长。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: Can you alter this wool coat? The sleeves cover half my hands.

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: Certainly. Put it on, and I will mark the length with pins.

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: Could you adjust the left sleeve a little more? It still feels longer than the right one.

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: Try lowering both arms. How does it feel now?

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: Much better. Please keep them at the lengths you have marked.

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: I can have it ready on Friday afternoon. The work will cost twenty pounds.

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: That is fine. I will come after three on Friday.
